evidence.locator: 2026-09-27_204320/tick_trace.tsv lines 2-278553; member sha256=4ec94be819e7a3f786cad044d8cfd0534d6c1b111e87e240b67320bdd91ad2d9; deterministic miner tools/mine_r6_state_edges.py; compact after-line witness artifact canonical/witnesses/CAP-R6-001/tick_state_edge_after_lines.v1.zlib.b64 sha256=abf605f1ee18a78e7c81ecbfded0cc604d48cc4f1f37b7050241df28e41ec03a
evidence.observation: Scanning raw tick_trace in line order and comparing each player's State string only with that player's immediately previous sampled row emits 5977 changes across 105 distinct ordered State-string pairs.

chain_edges.from: same-player consecutive sampled tick_trace rows with differing State strings

evidence.locator: tools/mine_r6_state_edges.py applied to the verified tick_trace; witness artifact stores 5977 strictly increasing raw after-line numbers. For each after-line, before-line is deterministically the immediately previous raw row for the same player_slot.

limits: This fact proves only recorded State-string changes at the tick_trace sampling boundary.
It does not assign gameplay meaning to any State string.
It does not prove DLL control flow, animation-bank meaning, timing meaning, root/facing ownership, choreography, damage causality, or aftermath semantics.
